arxiv-1702-06774.title: Properties of bottomonium in a relativistic quark model
arxiv-1702-06774.creator: Manjunath Bhat, Antony Prakash Monteiro, K. B. Vijaya Kumar
arxiv-1702-06774.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Manjunath Bhat, Antony Prakash Monteiro, K. B. Vijaya Kumar. The mass spectrum of b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} states has been obtained using the phenomenological relativistic quark model (RQM). The Hamiltonian used in the investigation has confinement potential and confined one gluon exchange potential (COGEP). In the frame work of RQM a study of M1 and E1 radiative decays of b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} states have been made. The weak decay widths in the spectator quark approximation have been estimated.

arxiv-2201-00704.title: Susceptibility of Polar Flocks to Spatial Anisotropy
arxiv-2201-00704.creator: Alexandre Solon, Hugues Chaté, John Toner, Julien Tailleur
arxiv-2201-00704.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexandre Solon, Hugues Chaté, John Toner, Julien Tailleur. We consider the effect of spatial anisotropy on polar flocks by investigating active q q -state clock models in two dimensions. In contrast to what happens in equilibrium, we find that, in the large-size limit, any amount of anisotropy changes drastically the phenomenology of the rotationally-invariant case, destroying long-range correlations, pinning the direction of global order, and transforming the traveling bands of the coexistence phase into a single moving domain.

arxiv-2208-08271.title: The distinguishing index of graphs with infinite minimum degree
arxiv-2208-08271.creator: Marcin Stawiski, Trevor M. Wilson
arxiv-2208-08271.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marcin Stawiski, Trevor M. Wilson. The distinguishing index D ′ ​ ( G ) D^{\prime}(G) of a graph G G is the least number of colors necessary to obtain an edge coloring of G G that is preserved only by the trivial automorphism. We show that if G G is a connected α \alpha -regular graph for some infinite cardinal α \alpha then D ′ ​ ( G ) ≤ 2 D^{\prime}(G)\leq 2 , proving a conjecture of Lehner, Pilśniak, and Stawiski.

arxiv-2307-04633.title: Realizing late-time cosmology in the context of Dynamical Stability Approach
arxiv-2307-04633.creator: Anirban Chatterjee, Saddam Hussain, Kaushik Bhattacharya
arxiv-2307-04633.description: Abstract We examine the scenario of non-minimally coupled relativistic fluid and k k -essence scalar field in a flat Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker universe. By adding a non-minimal coupling term in the Lagrangian level, we study the variation of Lagrangian with respect to independent variables, which produces modified scalar field and Friedmann equations.

arxiv-2307-07100.title: The asymptotic behaviors of the colored Jones polynomials of the figure eight-knot, and an affine representation Thanks: The author is supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers JP20K03601, JP22H01117, JP20K03931.
arxiv-2307-07100.creator: Hitoshi Murakami
arxiv-2307-07100.description: Abstract . We study the asymptotic behavior of the N N -dimensional colored Jones polynomial of the figure-eight knot evaluated at exp ⁡ ( ( κ + 2 ​ p ​ π ​ − 1 / N ) CLOSE \exp\bigl((\kappa+2p\pi\sqrt{-1}/N\bigr) , where κ := arccosh ⁡ ( 3 / 2 ) \kappa:=\operatorname{arccosh}(3/2) and p p is a positive integer.

arxiv-2311-03255.title: Minimal Arrangements of Spherical Geodesics
arxiv-2311-03255.creator: Giovanni Viglietta
arxiv-2311-03255.description: Abstract We study arrangements of geodesic arcs on a sphere, where all arcs are internally disjoint and each arc has its endpoints located within the interior of other arcs. We establish fundamental results concerning the minimum number of arcs in such arrangements, depending on local geometric constraints such as one-sidedness and k k -orientation .

arxiv-2406-10722.title: GenMM: Geometrically and Temporally Consistent Multimodal Data Generation for Video and LiDAR
arxiv-2406-10722.creator: Bharat Singh, Viveka Kulharia, Luyu YangAvinash RavichandranAmbrish TyagiAshish Shrivastava Cruise LLC {bharat.singh, viveka.kulharia, luyu.yang, avinash.ravichandran, ambrish.tyagi, ashish.shrivastava}@getcruise.com
arxiv-2406-10722.description: Abstract Multimodal synthetic data generation is crucial in domains such as autonomous driving, robotics, augmented/virtual reality, and retail. We propose a novel approach, GenMM, for jointly editing RGB videos and LiDAR scans by inserting temporally and geometrically consistent 3D objects. Our method uses a reference image and 3D bounding boxes to seamlessly insert and blend new objects into target videos.

arxiv-2408-08978.title: See What LLMs Cannot Answer: A Self-Challenge Framework for Uncovering LLM Weaknesses
arxiv-2408-08978.creator: Yulong Chen, Yang Liu, Jianhao Yan, Xuefeng Bai, Ming Zhong, Yinghao Yang Ziyi Yang Chenguang Zhu Yue Zhang
arxiv-2408-08978.description: Abstract The impressive performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) has consistently surpassed numerous human-designed benchmarks, presenting new challenges in assessing the shortcomings of LLMs. Designing tasks and finding LLMs’ limitations are becoming increasingly important. In this paper, we investigate the question of whether an LLM can discover its own limitations from the errors it makes.

arxiv-2502-02889.title: From DeepSense to Open RAN: AI/ML Advancements in Dynamic Spectrum Sensing and Their Applications
arxiv-2502-02889.creator: Ryan Barker
arxiv-2502-02889.description: Abstract The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) in next-generation wireless communication systems has become a cornerstone for advancing intelligent, adaptive, and scalable networks. This reading report examines key innovations in dynamic spectrum sensing (DSS), beginning with the foundational DeepSense framework, which uses convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and spectrogram-based analysis for real-time wideband spectrum monitoring.

arxiv-2502-09963.title: Generating on Generated: An Approach Towards Self-Evolving Diffusion Models
arxiv-2502-09963.creator: Xulu Zhang, Xiaoyong Wei, Jinlin Wu, Jiaxin Wu, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Zhen Lei, Qing Li
arxiv-2502-09963.description: Abstract Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) enables intelligence systems to autonomously refine their capabilities. This paper explores the application of RSI in text-to-image diffusion models, addressing the challenge of training collapse caused by synthetic data. We identify two key factors contributing to this collapse: the lack of perceptual alignment and the accumulation of generative hallucinations.

arxiv-2509-11842.title: More solutions to the decoration transformation
arxiv-2509-11842.creator: Erdal Catak a and Mustafa Mullahasanoglu b,c
arxiv-2509-11842.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate new solutions to the decoration transformation in terms of various special functions, including the hyperbolic gamma function, the basic hypergeometric function, and the Euler gamma function. These solutions to the symmetry transformation are important to decorate Ising-like integrable lattice spin models obtained via the gauge/YBE correspondence.

arxiv-2510-26132.title: Embodied Intelligence for Advanced Bioinspired Microrobotics: Examples and Insights Thanks: The research presented in this paper was partially funded by the Washington State University (WSU) Foundation and the Palouse Club through a Cougar Cage Award to N. O. P.-A. ; the US National Science Foundati
arxiv-2510-26132.creator: Néstor O. Pérez-Arancibia
arxiv-2510-26132.description: Abstract The term embodied intelligence (EI) conveys the notion that body morphology, material properties, interaction with the environment, and control strategies can be purposefully integrated into the process of robotic design to generate intelligent behavior; in particular, locomotion and navigation.

arxiv-2511-00348.title: Ultralow-power standoff acoustic leak detection
arxiv-2511-00348.creator: Michael P. Hasselbeck
arxiv-2511-00348.description: Abstract An automated, standoff acoustic leak detection scheme has been designed, built, and tested. It merges the principles of glass breakage and smoke detection to alert for the presence of leaks emanating from pressurized plumbing. A simulated water leak flowing at 0.15 l/min has been reliably detected at a standoff distance of more than 10 m.

arxiv-2511-09534.title: Optimising the 3-channel microfluidic system to investigate chemical gradient impacts on bacterial chemotaxis in fluid and near surfaces
arxiv-2511-09534.creator: Adam Gargasson, Julien Bouvard, Carine Douarche, Peter Mergaert, Harold Auradou, [4pt] Université Paris-Saclay, CNRS, FAST, 91405 Orsay, France
arxiv-2511-09534.description: Abstract Bacteria can adjust their swimming behaviour in response to chemical variations, a phenomenon known as chemotaxis. This process is characterised by a drift velocity that depends non-linearly on the concentration of the chemical species and its local gradient. To study this process more effectively, we optimised a 3-channel microfluidic device designed to create a stable gradient of chemoattractants.

britannica-1911-croup.description: Article 'Croup' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. hoarseness of speech. pmc-10757690.title: Infertility Burden Across Indian States: Insights from a Nationally Representative Survey Conducted During 2019–21
pmc-10757690.creator: Varun Agiwal, R Sai Madhuri, Sirshendu Chaudhuri
pmc-10757690.description: Background:Infertility is an escalating global concern, impacting approximately one-sixth of the reproductive age population worldwide. Employing data from the National Family Health Survey-5 (NFHS-5, 2019–21), this study assessed the prevalence of primary infertility at both national and state levels in India.

pmc-11434709.title: Shading and Water Addition Alleviate the Elemental Limitations of the Early Restoration Community in a Stressful Environment
pmc-11434709.creator: Fajun Chen, Gaojuan Zhao, Youxin Shen, Hong Zhu, Zhenjiang Li, Beilin Tan
pmc-11434709.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Shading and water addition are essential management measures to improve seed germination and early seedling survival; however, little is known about their effects on leaf stoichiometry and nutrient status. We established 90 plant communities with shading and water addition gradients on a rocky hill; leaves of their dominant woody plant species were collected to measure elemental concentrations, and then, stoichiometric variation and nutrient status were analysed.

pmc-11464685.title: Topic selection for text classification using ensemble topic modeling with grouping, scoring, and modeling approach
pmc-11464685.creator: Daniel Voskergian, Rashid Jayousi, Malik Yousef
pmc-11464685.description: TextNetTopics (Yousef et al. in Front Genet 13:893378, 2022. 10.3389/fgene.2022.893378) is a recently developed approach that performs text classification-based topics (a topic is a group of terms or words) extracted from a Latent Dirichlet Allocation topic modeling as features rather than individual words.

pmc-11671223.title: CareHPV, Papanicolaou Positivity Status, and Their Association With Behavioral Risk Factors in Rural Women of Kamrup District, Assam, India
pmc-11671223.creator: Pallavi Sarma, Debabrata Barmon, Avdhesh Kumar Rai, Amal Chandra Kataki, Anupam Sarma, Upasana Baruah, Lopamudra Kakoti, Debanjana Barman, Ratnadeep Sharma
pmc-11671223.description: Background and ObjectivesScreening of rural women of Assam by careHPV test for high‐risk HPV (hr‐HPV) DNA and Papanicolaou (PAP) test for abnormal cytology.MethodThis prospective cross‐sectional study included 480 non‐pregnant women participants aged 20–70 years from Kamrup District, Assam. Two cervical scrap samples were obtained from eligible enrolled women.

pmc-12377373.title: Combined Hyaluronic Acid Nanobioconjugates Impair CD44-Signaling for Effective Treatment Against Obesity: A Review of Comparison with Other Actors
pmc-12377373.creator: Daniel Ejim Uti, Wilson Achu Omang, Esther Ugo Alum, Okechukwu Paul-Chima Ugwu, Margaret Amieibi Wokoma, Rowland Inalegwu Oplekwu, Item Justin Atangwho, Godwin Eneji Egbung
pmc-12377373.description: CD44, a key hyaluronic acid (HA) receptor, has emerged as a central mediator of adipose tissue inflammation, remodeling, and insulin resistance in obesity. Its overexpression in obese adipose depots promotes leukocyte infiltration, pro-inflammatory signaling, and extracellular matrix dysregulation processes that underlie metabolic dysfunction.

pmc-12574873.title: Multiplets in scRNA-seq data: Extent of the problem and efficacy of methods for removal
pmc-12574873.creator: Dimitris Ttoouli, Daniel Hoffmann, Nagarajan Raju, Nagarajan Raju, Nagarajan Raju
pmc-12574873.description: Multiplets—droplets that capture more than one cell—are a known artefact in droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), yet their prevalence and impact remain underestimated. In this study, we assess the frequency of multiplets across diverse publicly available datasets and evaluate how well commonly used detection tools are able to identify them.

pmc-12840064.title: Reliability and Construct Validity of the Communication Function Classification System (CFCS) in an Italian Population of Children with Cerebral Palsy
pmc-12840064.creator: Azzurra Speroni, Gessica Della Bella, Antonella Cerchiari, Ester Mignolli, Marco Tofani
pmc-12840064.description: Background/objectives: Communication difficulties are highly prevalent among children with cerebral palsy (CP) and have a significant impact on participation, psychosocial development, and quality of life. The Communication Function Classification System (CFCS) was developed to provide a standardized framework for describing functional communication performance across five ordinal levels.

pmc-13101502.title: Viruses in marine sediments: a review of their effect on biogeochemistry and microbial interactions
pmc-13101502.creator: Jacob R. A. Williams, Jennifer F. Biddle
pmc-13101502.description: Viruses are known to impact the flow of carbon through the environment, while also impacting the microbial community around them. While this has been reexamined in recent years in the marine water column, viral impacts on marine sediments, the microbes, and carbon contained within are due for a reassessment.

pmc-13585810.title: Is methylphenidate truly cardiac-safe? Insight from biventricular speckle tracking echocardiography in pediatric patients with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
pmc-13585810.creator: Ahmed Osama Abd Rab El Rasool, Alshimaa Badreldeen, Doaa El Amrousy, Osama Younes
pmc-13585810.description: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a common neurodevelopmental condition identified by inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity. ADHD pharmacotherapy, particularly methylphenidate (MPH), has raised concerns about its cardiovascular safety. We aimed to assess the impact of methylphenidate on cardiac function in pediatric patients with ADHD using two-dimensional speckle tracking echocardiography (2D-STE).
